description: Goods transport by road in Jordan (Land Transport Regulatory Commission data) is a series of data sets listed in opendata.gov.jo, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Regulatory Authority (Land Transport Regulatory Commission). the offices that have obtained a license to engage in road freight brokerage. Coverage: Jordan. The portal lists 28 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Regulatory Authority (Land Transport Regulatory Commission). Its tags are Road freight brokerage. It offers 1 resource(s) in XLS. The portal shows 2025-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Jordonian License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, road safety and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-jo-portal.
